title: Hearty Sweet American Ham Bake
description: A festive and juicy American dish featuring dark soft brown sugar, this hearty bake is perfect for special occasions, with a yeasty twist and a dash of friendly flavors.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the dark brown sugar, honey, Dijon mustard, and black pepper.
Place the bone-in ham on a baking sheet lined with aluminum foil.
Brush the sugar and honey mixture evenly over the ham.
Arrange the pineapple rings and cherries around the ham.
Sprinkle the yeast over the top of the ham.
Bake the ham in the preheated oven for 15 minutes per pound.
Broil the ham for an additional 5 minutes to caramelize the sugar.
Let the ham rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
